name: ITI Ltd
about: ITI Limited is engaged in manufacturing, trading and servicing of telecommunication equipment, and rendering other associated and ancillary services. The Company focuses on offering telephone communication services. [1]
key_points: Business Overview: [1] [2] ITI is a Government-controlled telecom-equipment manufacturer and turnkey systems integrator operating six plants at Bengaluru, Naini, Raebareli, Mankapur, Srinagar and Palakkad, supported by an in-house Bengaluru R&D centre and a nationwide project-services network. Its product and service stack includes: a) 4G eNodeBs, baseband units, remote radio heads and outdoor cabinets, etc. b) ⁠ ONT, OLT and GPON access equipment c)⁠ Optical-fibre cable and HDPE ducts d)⁠ Defence encryptors and secure communication networks e) ⁠Datacentre, cloud and security-operation-centre services f) ⁠Solar modules and streetlights g) Smart cards and IT hardware h) Installation, commissioning and maintenance of large telecom and defence networks.

profile.summary: ITI Limited engages in the manufacture, sale, and servicing of telecommunication equipment and building communication network infrastructures in India. The company's telecom products and solutions include switching, transmission, access, and subscriber premises equipment. It also offers 4G radio equipment, and defence electronics products and systems; encryptors for defence; and other telecom products, including laptops /smaash PCs, solar panels/ modules/ power packs, optical fiber cable, HDPE, ONT, OLT, ODC, and telephones and smart cards. In addition, the company is involved in contract manufacturing of water pipes, 4G RAN Equipment, Tablet PC, etc. Further, it provides optical fiber cable, solar panel, HDPE manufacturing; smart energy meters; surface mount technology assembly; 3D printing; military telephones; SARAL tablet; GPON; data center; and operates VSSC component screening and telecom testing center. Additionally, the company builds communication networks using internet protocol/multi-protocol label switching technology, optical fibre cable, microwave radio, and satellite communication channels; provides customized support; and engages in turnkey contracts/solutions. ITI Limited was founded in 1948 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
